newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 3.2 bln marks in 5-day quick tender.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 3.2 bln marks in 5-day quick tender.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Friday it allocated 3.2 billion marks in 5-day securities repurchase funds at a fixed three percent rate.

The central bank this morning set the so-called quick tender to add liquidity to the money market, where rates had climbed sharply to 3.20 percent Thursday as dealers reacted to the Bundesbank's higher-than-expected 40 billion mark reserve rate target.
On Wednesday the Bundesbank awarded 74.2 billion marks in repos which the market thought was not sufficient.
